image.description: A thin wall (testdata/wall_test.ply), near face at x=5, sensor at origin height z=1. The wall is only visible from the subset of the 360-degree sweep's azimuth columns that actually point at it -- there is no single 'boresight column' the way a fixed-FOV sensor fixture would have. What's real and stable across the whole capture is the RANGE (row) of the wall's echo, summed across all columns: row_energy_peak_row stays at 118-119 for the vast majority of frames (occasional single-frame outliers -- startup transients or unrelated system load -- are tolerated via a majority-consensus check, see radarays_ros_fixture_harness.py).
